TTransform.SetOriginX.text: Sets the design x that is at the left edge of the view.

TTransform.SetOriginY.text: Sets the design y that is at the top edge of the view.

TTransform.SetOrigin.text: Sets the design point at the top left of the view.

TTransform.SetYIsUp.text: Makes y point upwards (used while drawing inside a symbol view).

TTransform.SetPixelOffset.text: Adds a fixed pixel offset to every converted position.

designtest.pas::DoStats.text: Test mode: loads a design and prints counts of objects by type and of resources.

designtest.pas::DoGeom.text: Test mode: probes the geometry of every non-symbol object in a design and prints the totals.

designtest.pas::DoRefs.text: Test mode: recomputes every reference point TinyCAD saved in a design from scratch and prints saved versus computed, so the program's result can be compared with the C++ program's.

params.GridOverride: grid to use instead of the file's (0 = the file's)
params.SnapOverride: snap flag to use instead of the file's (-1 = the file's)

designtest.pas::DoPlaced.text: Test mode: runs the placed-symbol checks (draw path versus netlist path, rotation, hit test, box, replace) over every placed symbol of a design and prints the totals.

params.GridOverride: grid to use instead of the file's
params.SnapOverride: snap flag to use instead of the file's

designtest.pas::DoFields.text: Test mode: recomputes the field label positions of every placed symbol and compares them with the saved ones.

designtest.pas::DoRoundTrip.text: Test mode: loads a design and writes it again (the round-trip test input).

doctest.pas::Esc.text: Escapes backslash, line feed and | so values can be printed on one line.

doctest.pas::F2.text: Formats a number for the test output.

AddObjects.text: Adds a few wires and junctions to a sheet so a test design has content.

DoMk.text: Test mode: builds a three-sheet design that uses every document-model feature (11x17, A4, portrait; automatic numbering, border, revision history with multi-line notes) and saves it.

doctest.pas::DoDump.text: Test mode: prints each sheet's page size, flags, border rectangle and revisions of a design.

DoExpand.text: Test mode: expands $(...) variables in a text for one sheet and prints the result.

DoIds.text: Test mode: assigns ids to a design, saves it and checks the ids survive a reload and a second save, that Clone gives no id and duplicates are repaired; prints a summary.

DoPaper.text: Test mode: prints the paper table, the 11 x 17 border and a few matching cases.

edittest.pas::FV.text: Reads token k of the command as a number.

edittest.pas::Fmt.text: Formats a number for the test output.

edittest.pas::Split.text: Splits a command line into tokens.

NewWorld.text: Starts a fresh design, sheet and wire engine for the next test scenario.

DoPoly.text: Draws a wire (or line) through the given points with the real tool: click, then move and click for each next point, then finish (right click or double click).

params.Dbl: True to finish with a double click

DoDrag.text: Draws a wire by press, drag and release.

DoSym.text: Places a library symbol (given library, row, position and rotation) on the test sheet.

DoPins.text: Prints the connection points of every placed symbol.

edittest.pas::DoDump.text: Prints the segments as the tool stored them (RAW), the wires and junctions that resulted, then END.

geomtest.pas::FV.text: Reads token k of the command as a number.

geomtest.pas::IV.text: Reads token k of the command as an integer.

geomtest.pas::Fmt@double.text: Formats a number for the test output ("nan" for not-a-number).

geomtest.pas::Fmt@tdpoint.text: Formats a point as two numbers.

geomtest.pas::Split.text: Splits a command line into tokens.

Repeated.text: A string of N letters x, used to give text objects a known length.

MakeStyle.text: Adds a line style of a given thickness to the test options.

CmdLD.text: Command LD: line distance from a point, printed with the nearest point.

CmdLI.text: Command LI: whether a line touches a rectangle.

CmdSN.text: Command SN: snaps a value to a grid.

CmdTF.text: Command TF: converts a point through the screen transform and back.

CmdPL.text: Command PL: lays out a pin (line, text positions) for given rotation, using fixed text metrics.

MakeSquare.text: Builds a rectangle or ellipse from the command's arguments.

CmdSQ.text: Command SQ: distance from a point to a rectangle or ellipse.

CmdSR.text: Command SR: whether a rectangle or ellipse overlaps a selection rectangle.

CmdPG.text: Command PG: polygon fill, distance and bounding box tests.

Rnd.text: A small deterministic random number generator, so tests repeat exactly.
Rnd.returns: a number from 0 up to but not including 1

RInt.text: A random integer in a range.

Check.text: Counts a check and a failure when the condition is False, printing the first failures.

InvPoints.text: Checks invariants of an object's geometry: rotating by 90 degrees four times returns to the start, mirroring twice does, and shifting then rotating matches rotating then shifting.

InvDirections.text: Checks the direction and symbol rotation tables: four turns return to the start, a mirror twice does, and left then right cancel.

CmdINV.text: Command INV: runs the invariant checks over randomly generated objects of every kind.

laddertest.pas::FV.text: Reads token k of the command as a number.

laddertest.pas::IV.text: Reads token k of the command as an integer.

laddertest.pas::Fmt.text: Formats a number for the test output.

laddertest.pas::Split.text: Splits a command line into tokens.

MakeLadder.text: Builds a ladder from the command's corner points, first and last line number and line count.

CmdGEOM.text: Command GEOM: prints the y and number of a line, the line a height falls in and the pitch.

CmdHIT.text: Command HIT: prints the click distance and "selected" result at a point.

CmdBOX.text: Command BOX: whether a selection rectangle touches the ladder.

CmdXML.text: Command XML: saves a design containing a ladder, reloads it and prints every property.

libtest.pas::Esc.text: Escapes backslash, line feed and | so values can be printed on one line.

SaveBytes.text: Writes text bytes to a file unchanged.

libtest.pas::DoDump.text: Test mode: prints every set, record and attribute of a library.

DoBlobs.text: Test mode: writes each set's stored drawing to a file.

DoSymbols.text: Test mode: loads every symbol of a library as a design symbol and prints its details.

DoBlobRT.text: Test mode: reads each stored drawing as a symbol document and writes it back, to test the round trip.

DoCopyLib.text: Test mode: copies a library by storing every set into a new file, to test the write path.

DoRestore.text: Test mode: deletes sets from a library and stores them back, then checks nothing was lost.

libtest.pas::DoGeom.text: Test mode: probes the geometry of every object in every symbol of a library.

libtest.pas::DoPlaced.text: Test mode: places every library symbol in all rotations with power pins on and off and runs the placed-symbol checks.

DoDelete.text: Test mode: deletes one set from a library.

modeltest.pas::Fmt.text: Formats a number for the test output.

PropLine.text: Lists the properties a selection shares, as a line of text.

DoProps.text: Test mode: builds objects of several kinds, checks which properties mixed selections share, does mass changes and saves the result.

modeltest.pas::DoLinks.text: Test mode: builds ladders and symbols on two sheets, adds linked texts and prints what they say as objects move, are renumbered and are deleted.

params.LibName: a library with at least one symbol

SaveState.text: Saves the design to a file so a state can be compared later.

Ids.text: The ids of a run of objects on a sheet.

modeltest.pas::DoUndo.text: Test mode: makes four edits (draw, delete, mass change, move) saving each state, then undoes and redoes them one at a time saving each state reached.

DoProtel.text: Test mode: writes the design's Protel netlist to a file.

nettest.pas::DoDump.text: Test mode: prints every net with its number, name and pins.

DoTwice.text: Test mode: builds the netlist twice and reports whether the numbering stays the same (it reads the hints the first run stored).

DoPersist.text: Test mode: builds the netlist, saves the design, reloads it and builds again, reporting whether the numbering survived.

Walk.text: Walks an XML document recursively and counts the tags by name.

DoCorpus.text: Test mode: reads an XML file and prints its tag counts (to compare with an independent parser).

DoSample.text: Test mode: reads a small XML sample and prints what the reader sees.

DoFmt.text: Test mode: prints numbers formatted with the C-compatible formatter for comparison with C printf.

DoUU.text: Test mode: UU-encodes and decodes data and compares with the C++ codec's output.

xmltest.pas::DoRoundTrip.text: Test mode: reads and writes XML back to a file; the round-trip check compares the two.
